lines.text: Which old cycles are worth fixing?
lines.phonemes: wˌɪtʃ ˈoʊld sˈaɪkəlz ɑːɹ wˈɜːθ fˈɪksɪŋ?

lines.text: A Mumbai shop has sold over 100 refurbished cycles.
lines.tts: A Mumbai shop has sold over a hundred refurbished cycles.
lines.phonemes: ɐ mʊmbˈaɪ ʃˈɑːp hɐz sˈoʊld ˌoʊvɚɹ ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd ɹᵻfˈɜːbɪʃt sˈaɪkəlz.

lines.text: Fix the ones with straight frames; strip the rest for parts.
lines.phonemes: fˈɪks ðə wˈʌnz wɪð stɹˈeɪt fɹˈeɪmz; stɹˈɪp ðə ɹˈɛst fɔːɹ pˈɑːɹts.

lines.text: Say ten scrap cycles cost ₹4,500; fixing seven costs ₹7,000.
lines.tts: Say ten scrap cycles cost forty-five hundred rupees; fixing seven costs seven thousand.
lines.phonemes: sˈeɪ tˈɛn skɹˈæp sˈaɪkəlz kˈɔst fˈɔːɹɾifˈaɪv hˈʌndɹɪd ɹˈuːpiːz; fˈɪksɪŋ sˈɛvən kˈɔsts sˈɛvən θˈaʊzənd.

lines.text: Seven sold at ₹2,000, plus scrap from three wrecks: about ₹3,500 left.
lines.tts: Seven sold at two thousand, plus scrap from three wrecks: about thirty-five hundred left.
lines.phonemes: sˈɛvən sˈoʊld æt tˈuː θˈaʊzənd, plˈʌs skɹˈæp fɹʌm θɹˈiː ɹˈɛks: ɐbˌaʊt θˈɜːɾifˈaɪv hˈʌndɹɪd lˈɛft.

lines.text: And every wreck is a cheap spare-parts shop.
lines.phonemes: ænd ˈɛvɹi ɹˈɛk ɪz ɐ tʃˈiːp spˈɛɹpˈɑːɹts ʃˈɑːp.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
